title: Sr. Product Test Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**

Serve as a senior product test specialist in a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in Selenium Core Java and cards and payment systems to validate complex transaction processing platforms. Design and execute robust automated test solutions that improve product quality reduce defects in production and ensure compliant secure and reliable payment experiences for customers worldwide.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement comprehensive automated test suites using Selenium and Core Java to validate complex cards and payment features across multiple applications and interfaces.
* Develop detailed test strategies and plans that cover functional regression integration and end to end testing for transaction processing and settlement workflows in the payment ecosystem.
* Create reusable test frameworks and utilities that standardize automation practices improve maintainability and accelerate test execution for card authorization and clearing processes.
* Analyze detailed business and technical requirements for cards and payment products and translate them into clear test scenarios and data conditions that reflect real world customer usage.
* Execute automated and targeted manual tests on day shifts in a hybrid work environment while coordinating closely with onshore and offshore colleagues to align on priorities and timelines.
* Identify document and track defects with precise technical details and collaborate with developers and product teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence.
* Validate transaction processing on the TPH platform by executing structured test cycles that confirm data integrity reconciliation accuracy and adherence to regulatory and compliance guidelines.
* Monitor and optimize test execution results by reviewing logs analyzing failures and fine tuning scripts to increase stability accuracy and coverage of critical card payment journeys.
* Collaborate with product owners business analysts and architects to clarify requirements refine acceptance criteria and ensure that test coverage aligns with customer expectations and service level objectives.
* Support production readiness assessments by providing clear test evidence coverage metrics and risk based recommendations that help stakeholders make informed release decisions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by evaluating new automation tools proposing enhancements to current frameworks and sharing best practices that strengthen the quality culture across teams.
* Mentor junior testers by reviewing their test cases suggesting improvements in automation design and guiding them on effective techniques for cards and payment testing.
* Ensure strict adherence to company quality standards and security practices while focusing on reliable payment experiences that build customer trust and support safe digital commerce at scale.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience of eight to twelve years in testing complex enterprise applications to design robust test approaches suited to high volume payment scenarios.
* Demonstrate strong hands on proficiency in Selenium for web based test automation including building modular scripts managing test data and integrating with execution pipelines.
* Use solid Core Java skills to develop automation frameworks custom utilities and reusable components that enable efficient validation of card transactions and payment flows.
* Bring proven exposure to cards and payment processing including concepts such as authorization clearing settlement interchange and dispute handling to design realistic test cases.
* Utilize practical experience with TPH or similar transaction processing hubs to validate message flows posting logic and reconciliation between upstream and downstream systems.
* Communicate effectively with cross functional stakeholders through clear defect reports concise status updates and well structured test documentation suited to hybrid collaboration.
* Adapt quickly to evolving product features regulatory changes and security requirements in the payments domain while maintaining a strong focus on risk based testing and customer impact.
* Prefer prior experience in additional cards and payments platforms or schemes as a nice to have background that broadens perspective on global payment standards and industry practices.

title: Senior Quality Analyst (Automation & Manual)
description:
Job Title: SDET (Software Development Engineer in Testing) – Senior Automation QA & Manual Testing

Experience: 8+ Years

At InxiteOut Pvt. Ltd., we specialize in building next-generation AI-powered applications that solve real-world business problems. We are expanding our QA team to ensure our AI systems are robust, secure, and aligned with user expectations.

o Advanced REST API Testing (Postman, REST Assured, etc.)

o Integration, Acceptance, E2E, Smoke, Sanity, System Testing

* Strong foundation in Non-Functional Testing:

o Performance and Load Testing

o Stress and Security Testing

* Proficiency in Testing Methods:

o Black-box, White-box, Grey-box Testing

* Regression Testing lifecycle ownership

* Hands-on experience with AI testing tools or custom frameworks.
* Familiarity with evaluating LLM (large language model) outputs.
* Experience of validating RAG-based architecture.
* Understanding of hallucination detection metrics and prompt tuning.
* Exposure to safety audits for AI applications.
* Collaboration experience with Full Stack, Data Science, Data Engineering & DevOps teams.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications in testing or security are a plus (e.g., ISTQB, OWASP).

title: Junior Security Analyst
description:
**1. Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)**

* Conduct vulnerability assessments and basic penetration testing of network devices, servers, applications, and IT infrastructure.
* Identify, validate, document, and prioritize security vulnerabilities based on risk and business impact.
* Use security assessment tools such as Nmap, Nessus, OpenVAS, Burp Suite, or equivalent tools.
* Prepare VAPT reports with findings, risk ratings, evidence, and remediation recommendations.
* Perform vulnerability retesting and track remediation activities.

**2. IT Infrastructure & Network Security Audits**

* Conduct security audits of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and network security appliances.
* Review firewall rules, access control lists (ACLs), NAT policies, VPN configurations, and administrative access controls.
* Audit switch configurations, VLAN segmentation, trunk ports, unused ports, port security, and management access.
* Review network architecture, access controls, network segmentation, and security configurations against established security standards.
* Identify configuration weaknesses and recommend corrective actions.

**3. Firewall & NMS Security**

* Review firewall configurations, rule bases, security policies, logging, and monitoring settings.
* Verify secure management access, role-based access controls, and configuration backup practices.
* Audit NMS platforms for device discovery, monitoring permissions, SNMP configurations, access control, and alerting.
* Check SNMP versions and configurations, prioritizing SNMPv3 and secure community-string handling where applicable.
* Review network device logs, monitoring alerts, and configuration changes for potential security issues.

**4. Security Compliance & Documentation**

* Assist in conducting internal security audits and compliance assessments.
* Evaluate configurations against organizational security policies, vendor hardening guidelines, and applicable security standards.
* Maintain audit checklists, evidence, vulnerability registers, and risk assessment reports.
* Prepare clear audit findings and actionable remediation recommendations.
* Coordinate with infrastructure and network teams to close identified security gaps.

**5. Security Monitoring & Incident Support**

* Review security logs and alerts to identify suspicious activities.
* Assist in initial investigation and escalation of security incidents.
* Support incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident documentation.
* Track security findings and follow up with responsible teams until closure.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of VAPT methodologies and penetration testing fundamentals.
* Understanding of network security, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, and subnetting.
* Practical knowledge of firewalls, switches, routers, VLANs, ACLs, and VPNs.
* Understanding of NMS platforms, SNMP, syslog, device monitoring, and network alerting.
* Familiarity with vulnerability scanning and security testing tools such as Nmap, Nessus, OpenVAS, and Burp Suite.
* Knowledge of firewall rule reviews, network device hardening, access control, and secure configuration practices.
* Understanding of Linux and Windows security fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of security standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, and NIST.
* Good report-writing, documentation, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.

Pay: ₹250,000.00 - ₹350,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* security audit (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
